AgentTasks.Goal: Implement a production-ready FIDO2/WebAuthn Relying Party Server in Rust that provides complete passwordless authentication capabilities. The server must support both **Registration (Attestation)** and **Authentication (Assertion)** flows with full FIDO Alliance specification compliance. Key endpoints to implement: 1. `POST /webauthn/attestation/options` — Start credential registration 2. `POST /webauthn/attestation/result` — Complete credential registration 3. `POST /webauthn/assertion/options` — Start authentication challenge 4. `POST /webauthn/assertion/result` — Complete authentication verification 5. `GET /webauthn/status` — Health check and server capabilities The implementation must use **webauthn-rs 0.5+** for all WebAuthn operations, support PostgreSQL for credential storage, provide comprehensive security controls (TLS enforcement, replay protection, rate limiting), and pass FIDO2 conformance tests. Architecture should support high availability, horizontal scaling, and enterprise deployment requirements. Execute tasks sequentially with confirmation checkpoints for quality assurance.
